{{Top|leg}}
The '''Kallistan Militia''' was a [[Militia/Legends|militia]] unit based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kallistas]]. They were under the command of [[Imperial Prefect]] [[Dengless Rinn]]. They were not numerous, perceptive or ambitious. Each militia [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] was armed with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], wore a [[Blast vest/Legends|blast vest]] and carried desert survival gear.
